Messages.Author: adam....@ngc.com
Messages.Body:
Just need a little clarify here...

First part states "During the first combat between an acting vampire
and blocking vampire each turn,..."

What exactly is "first combat"? Does it apply to acting minion,
blocking, or both?

If the acting vampire untaps (ie freak drive) and is blocked by a
different vampire, does this still apply? Or does he have to be blocked
by the same vampire (ie wake and block)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
<adam....@ngc.com> wrote in message news:1108473646.6...@z14g2000cwz.googlegroups.com...

> Just need a little clarify here...
>
> First part states "During the first combat between an acting vampire
> and blocking vampire each turn,..."
>
> What exactly is "first combat"?

The one that occurs before any other acting-to-blocking combat on that turn.

>Does it apply to acting minion,
> blocking, or both?

Card text: "neither combatant"

> If the acting vampire untaps (ie freak drive) and is blocked by a
> different vampire, does this still apply? Or does he have to be blocked
> by the same vampire (ie wake and block)

Neither. It only applies to the first block-induced combat in
a turn.
